purpose: Track industry-standard parity evidence before the v2.0.0 release candidate.
public_claim_boundary: CivicCast may claim software feature parity where implementation and local proof exist. It must not claim app-store publication, hardware certification, legal certification, managed-service operation, or live-device validation unless the linked evidence explicitly proves that claim.

gaps.name: Native OTT and mobile app suite
gaps.software_claim: Shared app contracts and reference shells exist for living-room, mobile, and web targets.
gaps.external_dependency: Store publication, platform developer accounts, device-lab certification, and signed production binaries remain external proof items.

gaps.name: Gated and private video access
gaps.software_claim: Playback policies, entitlements, channel inheritance, public catalog enforcement, RSS gating, and operator controls are implemented.

gaps.name: VOD preroll messaging
gaps.software_claim: Preroll policy metadata and playback policy enforcement are part of the same gated playback backbone.

gaps.name: Full multi-zone CG bulletin board
gaps.software_claim: Multi-zone CG templates, queueing, feed adapters, snapshots, operator editing, and HLS render planning are implemented.

gaps.name: AV router control
gaps.software_claim: Router inventory, manual take planning, scheduled take planning, RS-232/TCP/UDP command previews, and operator controls are implemented.
gaps.external_dependency: Live facility router hardware validation requires attached station equipment and explicit operator authorization.

gaps.name: Caption appliance integration
gaps.software_claim: External SRT, WebVTT, and decoded caption appliance payloads can enter the existing caption review queue.
gaps.external_dependency: Live caption appliance validation requires an attached appliance or partner-provided sample feed.

gaps.name: Squeezebacks and L-bar live overlays
gaps.software_claim: Overlay z-order, L-bar, squeezeback, bug, lower-third, and emergency overlay compositor plans are implemented and exposed in the operator UI.
gaps.external_dependency: Live GPU/HLS compositor execution against real program material remains external runtime proof.

gaps.name: RTMP cloud ingest relay
gaps.software_claim: Remote ingest relay configuration, live ingest plans, deployment guidance, and operator visibility are implemented.
gaps.external_dependency: Live hosted relay proof requires a provisioned relay endpoint and network credentials.

gaps.name: Expanded audience measurement and reporting
gaps.software_claim: Analytics reporting backbone, operator reports, privacy docs, GA4 export, and EPG export support are implemented.
gaps.external_dependency: Provider-side analytics proof requires configured external analytics properties or production traffic.

gaps.name: Contributor submission portal
gaps.software_claim: Contributor contracts, public submission/status surfaces, operator review controls, status outbox, and test package are implemented.
